senses.gloss: m. (בהר; b. h. white, white spot (cloud).—Pl. בְּהִירִין, בְּהוֹ׳.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 7b:11">Taan. 7ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Job 37:21">Job XXXVII, 21</cite>) <he>אפי׳ בשעה שהעננים עומדין בהי׳ בהי׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. M., even when the clouds stand in white spots, there comes a wind &c.; edit. <he>שרקיע נעשה בהו׳ בהו׳</he> the sky is made (to appear) full of white clouds.
